clinician.trajectory_summary: A 20-year-old woman with chronic asymmetry of the left thigh since childhood presented with acute painful worsening of the swelling. Physical examination showed marked left thigh enlargement without signs of infection or thrombosis. Genetic testing later confirmed a pathogenic RASA1 gene variant (Chr5(GRCh37)g.86659154_86659158del), confirming the diagnosis of Parkes-Weber syndrome. Vascular imaging studies were ordered but not documented in the source report. The clinical presentation combined with genetic confirmation established the diagnosis.
